title: AIS4 production evidence contract
description: SECB-WP-FWK-089, issue #158. Describes evidence that MIGHT support AIS4_INDEPENDENT_DOMAINS. It is the Tranche A half of the work package: the shape a verifier can check, not a substrate. VERIFIER_AVAILABLE != SUBSTRATE_AVAILABLE != INDEPENDENCE_OBSERVED. No document conforming to this schema provisions an App, a custody domain or a policy domain, and conformance is necessary rather than sufficient -- the eight promotion conjuncts are evidenced individually by scripts/check_ais_production_evidence.py, which computes the observed level and never reads a claimed one. A document that ASSERTS its own level is refused rather than believed, so no level field exists here to assert it with.

snapshot.description: The immutable thing every principal must be bound to. Independent decisions about DIFFERENT snapshots are not a quorum, they are a coincidence.

jwks.description: The key set the OIDC signatures are checked against, and -- separately -- where that key set came from. A signature that verifies against a key the repository supplied proves the document is internally consistent, not that an issuer signed it. Hence provenance is a required, declared field: LOCAL_FIXTURE is honest and caps the level; claiming ISSUER_DISCOVERY without a discovery record is laundering and is refused.

discovery.description: Required when provenance is ISSUER_DISCOVERY. Records the fetch that produced the keys, so the claim is checkable rather than asserted.

principals.description: Role name -> principal evidence. The role NAME is a label and proves nothing; every separation dimension below is a separate field precisely so that one cannot stand in for another.

custody_domain.description: Who holds the private key. Two principals whose credentials are readable by one runtime share a custody domain however many Apps they have.

policy_domain.description: Which trust policy governs this principal.

policy_administered_by.description: The policy domain that ADMINISTERS this principal's policy. Must not be this principal's own policy_domain: a principal that edits the policy validating its own decisions is its own auditor.

revocation.description: Revocation must be OBSERVED denied, not inferred from an API accepting a revoke call. REVOKE_ACCEPTED != REUSE_DENIED.

token.description: Compact JWS. Claims are read from the token, never from a parallel copy: a decoded-claims field beside the token is a second source of truth that can disagree with the signed one.

ballots.description: Independently executed decisions. Each names the principal that cast it and the snapshot digest it was cast against.

roles.description: Which principal performs each effect. Separate from `principals` so that effect separation is checkable: an executor that also votes, or that also verifies its own readback, collapses the separation the ballots are supposed to provide.

attestation.description: Optional. Generation has no security value until signature, timestamp and signer identity are independently verified, so an unverified attestation contributes nothing and an attestation presented as verified without a verifier record is refused.
